title: How to Fix Disabled Accounts Can't be contacted Instagram 2026, its meaning, Blocked or Deactivated?
description:
Watch here to find out How to Fix Disabled Accounts Can't be Contacted " on Instagram 2026, Meaning Blocked or Deactivated.

In this video, I’m going to show you how to resolve the issue of “Disabled accounts can’t be contacted” on Instagram.

Sometimes, when you try to send a direct message (DM) to someone on Instagram, you might encounter an error message that says exactly that.
This message usually means that the account you’re trying to reach has either been disabled or deactivated by Instagram.
Additionally, you won’t be able to send direct messages to friends who have temporarily deactivated their Instagram accounts — at least not until they reactivate their accounts by logging back in.

However, the main issue right now is that this error message often appears even when the person you’re trying to message has already reactivated their account. This is where a lot of confusion happens.

To help you fix this problem, here are a few steps you can try.
But before we begin, if you’re new to the channel, please subscribe and turn on the notification bell so you don’t miss future updates!

Solution 1: Restrict and Unrestrict the Account
1️⃣ Go to your chat section and open the conversation with the person you’re trying to message.
2️⃣ Tap on their name at the top of the chat.
3️⃣ Tap on the three dots (or options menu) and select “Restrict.”
4️⃣ After restricting, go back to your Instagram homepage.
5️⃣ Tap your profile icon in the bottom right.
6️⃣ Tap the three-line menu in the top right to access Settings.
7️⃣ Scroll down and select “Restricted accounts.”
8️⃣ Search for the account you restricted, and then choose “Unrestrict.”

Now go back to your chat section, open the conversation again, and try sending a message. It should work!

Solution 2: Block and Unblock the Account
If the first solution didn’t help, try this:
✅ Block the account, then unblock it.
✅ After unblocking, try sending your message again — in most cases, this will resolve the error.

Solution 3: Delete the Chat and Re-Follow
If the issue still isn’t fixed:
➡ Delete your entire conversation with that person.
➡ Unfollow their account.
➡ Then follow them again.
➡ Open a new chat and try sending a message — it should go through now.

Final Steps: App Troubleshooting
If none of these solutions work, the problem might be related to your Instagram app or account.
➡ Make sure you’ve updated Instagram to the latest version.
➡ You can also try uninstalling and reinstalling the app to clear any hidden issues.

And that’s it! Hopefully, this helps you fix the “Disabled accounts can’t be contacted” error.
If you found this guide helpful, don’t forget to like the video, comment below if you have questions, and subscribe for more Instagram solutions!
